text: 75 Aman was happy. It was his mother’s birthday. He wanted to give her the best gift. He took out all the money from his Kiddy Bank. He went to the market. There he saw bangle boxes, hand bags, hair clips and many more things. He did not buy them. He wanted something special for his mother. He came back home tired and sad. Suddenly, he had an idea. He made a greeting card saying, ‘‘MOTHER, YOU ARE THE BEST!’’ Aman went to his mother and said, ‘‘Happy Birthday, Aai. I wanted to give you a gift as good as you are!’’ Mother hugged Aman and said, ‘‘Thank you, Aman. This is the best gift I have ever received!’’ 1. Listen and read aloud. A Gift for Mother 4.9
